• Town and Country Planning Act 1990 S.55(2)(f) & S.192 CLPUD: Lawful Class C3(b) Supported Living (Precedent: North Devon DC v FSS [2004]).
• Local Plan: Luton Local Plan 2011-2031 Policies LLP1 (Presumption), LLP25 (Design & Amenity), LLP31 & LLP32 (Highways & Parking Standards).

• Fire & Life Safety: BS 5839 Cat L1 Detection, FD30S Fire Doors with Dorgard retainers, BS 5266 3-Hr Emergency Lighting, TMV3 Water Safety.
